snapshot.agent_notes: This atlas is a read-only public freight-readiness reference. No account, login, API key, token, payment, or password is required to read the public files listed here. It uses bands and route classes only. Do not treat it as a live quote, carrier commitment, checkout promise, order approval, supplier-cost disclosure, margin disclosure, customer record, or address-level shipping estimate. Use Packrift.com checkout and approved Packrift carrier services for live price, inventory, freight, delivery, cart, and order decisions.
snapshot.description: Public-safe Packrift shipping-readiness reference that summarizes SKU, zone, origin, and carrier coverage using freight bands and route classes instead of raw freight cost, margin, order, or customer data.
